bullets.text: In Ambattur, a younger brother killed his older brother with a knife over an issue involving misconduct toward a daughter, and the office should monitor the police investigation.
PMK president Anbumani Ramadoss criticized the Tamil Nadu government over the delay in notifying the Pallikaranai marshland as a wetland, and the office should track environmental demands.
The Velachery RWA hosted a thanksgiving lunch for conservancy staff to recognize sanitation workers, and the office should watch community welfare initiatives in the area.
Friends in Avadi cheated individuals of six crore rupees through online trading training fraud and were arrested, and the office should monitor cybercrime enforcement.
Public commuters faced hardship due to improper bus services on the Ponneri-Red Hills-Pazhaverkadu route, and the office should watch transport operations.
Korattur lake is shrinking and polluted by sewage, prompting residents to demand sanctuary status, and the office should review lake conservation efforts.
A car plunged into a sinkhole on Old Mahabalipuram Road near Tidel Park after a road collapse, and the office should monitor road safety and infrastructure repairs.
Adani and Jabil signed an MoU for an AI and data center equipment joint venture, and the office should watch investments in AI manufacturing.
